subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Scenario Planning
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Scenario Planning.

hook.text: What if tariffs rise 25%? What if a key supplier goes bankrupt? Scenario planning asks 'what if' before it happens.

buildup.text: Scenario planning creates multiple demand forecasts for different possible futures.

discovery.text: Each scenario models a different set of assumptions: economic growth, market shifts, or supply disruptions.

twist.text: The goal isn't to predict which scenario will happen. It's to prepare responses for each one.

climax.text: Companies with scenario plans responded 3x faster to COVID disruptions than those with single-plan forecasts.

punchline.text: Plan for several futures. React faster when one arrives.

quiz.question: What is the goal of scenario planning?
options: To prepare responses for multiple possible futures
